limitations.note: The agent fixed the inverted RAM read enable but also rewrote the pointer logic, registered both status flags, and gated RAM enables with reset, changing cycle-by-cycle behavior that the one-line fix preserves.
The scoreboard used the DUT’s own flags to decide when transfers occurred and checked flag values only at coarse checkpoints, so it verified FIFO ordering without detecting the altered flag timing.
The failed Git check prevented the chained file search from running, so the agent had to issue that search separately.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted.
limitations.note: The cleanup trap caused the tool to reject the entire invocation, so no simulation ran and the testbench had to be submitted again.
